Here’s how to move that one “Teacher Meeting” in Google Calendar without changing anything else:

1) Open the event
- Go to https://calendar.google.com.
- Navigate to Friday, December 12, 2025.
- Click the “Teacher Meeting” event (3:00–4:00 PM).

2) Open it in edit mode
- In the event pop-up, click the pencil icon (Edit event).

3) Change only the date
- In the date field next to the time, change:
  - From: Fri, Dec 12, 2025  
  - To: Sat, Dec 13, 2025

  - Time zone shows Pacific Time (PT) or the correct local PT zone.

- When asked if you want to send updates to guests, click “Send”.
